about: Project-owned contract (T008 A-01). docs/spec/contracts stays unchanged; tools/project_contract.py applies these amendments to its schemas and request bodies. Unnamed schemas are the spec's. Consumers (apps/api tests, apps/web/src/api.ts guards) enforce the rule below; a null receipt or qualification never makes a proposal actionable.
changes: 0.2.0: fields no store holds yet become nullable (account, account_snapshot, proposal); snapshot gains ledger_cash (trade-date journal cash, not available cash) and coverage; pages gain the C-02 coverage; the active-proposal rule accepts a null final-check receipt or qualification. 0.3.0: claim and evidence gain coverage (withheld text, invalid citations and limitations are named there); claim material becomes nullable (no store records materiality). 0.4.0: proposal gains coverage (readProposal returns one proposal, so its nulls are named on the item; list items carry it too); ledger_event lot_policy_id becomes nullable (the journal stores a lot-policy name such as economic_average_cost/1, which is not a contract id; it is served in economic_annotations). 0.5.0: the request WatchlistEntry (addWatchlistEntry, updateWatchlistEntry) gains an optional, nullable review_at (RFC 3339 with an offset, normalized to UTC; on update, omitting it keeps the stored value); needs stays server-derived and is refused in requests. If-Match on every route: a stale or malformed value is 412 Precondition Failed and a required but missing one is 428 Precondition Required; this replaces the 409 that the OpenAPI If-Match descriptions name.
rule: A null in an amended field must be named in the response coverage.reasons as unavailable:<field>, unavailable:<id>/<field>, unknown:<field> or none:<id>/<field>.

ledger_cash.description: Trade-date journal cash per currency; not available cash.
